title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
看着得到建议后，信心满满离开的秦姝，林枫忍不住摇了摇头。自己只是说了一句让她注意一下杰尼龟以后使用撞击的时候，抬头，她就恍然大悟，顿时知道了这次对战失败的原因了。马上带着杰尼龟去做针对性训练...可是...“打不过的原因怎么可能是撞击的熟练度不够？”“藤藤...”藤藤蛇也没绷住...“算了，我们去市区吧？你要进精灵球吗？”林枫拿出精灵球询问道。“藤藤？”（可以不吗？）看着林枫手上的精灵球，藤藤蛇露出了嫌弃的表情，它可不想待在那个狭窄的空间里面。“行，那你是被我抱着还是站我肩膀上？不然，你是上不了公交车的。”精灵法明确规定，在公共交通工具上，不能有大型宝可梦，而且训练家必须和自己的宝可梦有接触。“藤藤？”藤藤蛇狐疑的看着他。“真的！”林枫认真的道。虽然也占据了一点，他想要将藤藤蛇抱在怀里面的意思。夏天嘛。冰冰凉凉的皮肤触感是最好的了。“藤藤...”藤藤蛇勉为其难的点了点头。......梧桐市宝可梦联盟分部。林枫抱着藤藤蛇，走了出来。刚开始这小家伙是只愿意待在肩膀上的，但很快，因为它本身的身高也不矮，站在肩膀上去坐公交车的话，就显得它非常突兀。这种突兀，让它觉得有些尴尬，退而其次，就只能待在林枫的怀里面了。其实也挺好...挺暖和的，就是那双手不要一直在身上上面摸来摸去就更好了...藤藤蛇心想道。有点怪不好意思的。证书下来的很快，接待员小姐姐也很漂亮，还夸赞林枫年少有为，这么年轻就成为了中级培育家。

还顺带着为林枫开启了培育屋的资格证书。“得买一些日常的绷带，好伤药之类的，还有制造保养能量方块的材料。”心中闪过这个念头，林枫大步走向联盟对面的旺旺超市。这是联盟最大的连锁百货超市，无论是宝可梦用品还是生活用品，在这里都能得到。可过了马路，林枫这才发现。在旺旺超市的门口，挂着一张很大的横幅。“成为一名优秀的训练家，必须从对战开始，时值暑期，由旺旺超市联名宝可梦联盟，举办一场新人训练家对战赛——宝宝杯，只要是新人训练家，就能免费参与哦！”“丰富奖励，等你带回家！”横幅的旁边，还有一张沙奈朵送上飞吻的动漫贴图，看样子，比赛的举办方很清楚这个年龄段的孩子，都会被什么抓住目光。让林枫在乎的不是这个。让他在乎的是...【一等奖：御三家宝可梦蛋一只，旺旺超市八万八千购物卡一张。旺旺超市总部猜蛋谜机会一次！】【二等奖：旺旺超市八万八千购物卡一张。旺旺超市总部猜蛋谜机会一次！】【三等奖：旺旺超市八万八千购物卡一张。】嗯....奖励好像有点丰富？林枫思索起来，恨不得目不转睛放在沙奈朵....下面的参赛时间和规则上面。7月15号。规则：只允许第一阶段的宝可梦参加，并且实力在精英以下。入门，普通，精英，道馆，霸主，天王，冠军...这是人类对神兽以下宝可梦实力的一个大概划分。如果是精英以下的话，那差不多就是0到20级之间的宝可梦都能参加。虽然说参加比赛，这跟自己成为培育家的想法有些冲突...但...奖励真的好多呀？“藤藤蛇，你怎么看？”于是乎，林枫将这个难题抛给了藤藤蛇。“藤藤？”“藤藤....”它摇了摇头，表示自己看不懂上面的字，上面全部内容，它只能认出一个沙奈朵...“你也同意了是吧？那好，我报名去了。”林枫兴致冲冲走进超市里面。
content_en:
Seeing Qin Shu leave with confidence after getting the advice, Lin Feng couldn't help but shake his head.He just said something to her to pay attention to when Squirtle used the impact in the future. When she raised her head, she suddenly understood and immediately knew the reason for the failure of this battle.Immediately took Squirtle for targeted training... But... "How could the reason for not being able to beat him be that he is not proficient enough in impact?" "Teng Teng..." Teng Teng Snake didn't hold back... "Forget it, let's go to the city? Do you want to enter the elf ball?" Lin Feng took out the elf ball and asked."Teng Teng?" (Is that okay?) Looking at the Poké Ball in Lin Feng's hand, the Teng Teng Snake showed a disgusted expression. It didn't want to stay in that narrow space."Okay, then are you going to be held by me or stand on my shoulder? Otherwise, you won't be able to get on the bus." Elf law clearly stipulates that large Pokémon cannot be allowed on public transportation, and trainers must have contact with their own Pokémon."Tengteng?" Tengteng Snake looked at him suspiciously."Really!" Lin Feng said seriously.Although it also occupied a little bit, he wanted to hold the Vine Snake in his arms.It's summer.The cool feeling on the skin is the best."Teng Teng..." Teng Teng Snake reluctantly nodded....Indus City Pokémon League Branch.Lin Feng walked out holding the Vine Snake in his arms.At first, this little guy was only willing to stay on his shoulders, but soon, because he was not short, it would look very awkward if he stood on his shoulders to take the bus.This suddenness made it feel a little embarrassed, so the next best thing was to stay in Lin Feng's arms.It's actually quite good...it's quite warm. It would be better if those hands don't touch it all the time...Teng Teng Snake thought to himself.It's a bit weird and embarrassing.The certificate came quickly, and the receptionist was also very beautiful. She also praised Lin Feng for his promising achievements and becoming an intermediate cultivator at such a young age.

He also opened the qualification certificate for the cultivation house for Lin Feng."I need to buy some daily bandages, good wound medicine, and materials for making and maintaining energy cubes." With this thought in his mind, Lin Feng strode towards the Want Want Supermarket opposite the alliance.This is the largest department store chain in the Alliance. Whether it is Pokémon supplies or daily necessities, you can get it here.But after crossing the road, Lin Feng realized it.At the entrance of Want Want Supermarket, there is a big banner hanging."Becoming an excellent trainer must start with battles. During the summer, Want Want Supermarket is co-branded with the Pokémon League to hold a new trainer battle competition - the Baby Cup. As long as you are a new trainer, you can participate for free!" "Rich rewards are waiting for you to take home!" Next to the banner, there is an anime sticker of Gardevoir blowing a kiss. It seems that the organizers of the competition know very well what will catch the attention of children of this age group.That's not what Lin Feng cares about.What he cares about is... [First prize: a Pokémon egg from Yusanjia, and a Want Want Supermarket 88,000 shopping card.One chance to guess the egg puzzle at Want Want Supermarket Headquarters!】【Second Prize: A Want Want Supermarket 88,000 shopping card.One chance to guess the egg puzzle at Want Want Supermarket Headquarters!】【Third Prize: A Want Want Supermarket 88,000 shopping card.】Hmm...the rewards seem a bit rich?Lin Feng thought about it, wishing that he could not take his eyes off Gardevoir...the competition time and rules below.July 15th.Rules: Only Pokémon in the first stage are allowed to participate, and their strength is below the elite level.Beginner, ordinary, elite, gym, overlord, king, champion... This is a rough division of the strength of Pokémon below mythical beasts by humans.If it is elite or lower, then almost all Pokémon between level 0 and level 20 can participate.Although participating in the competition somewhat conflicts with my idea of ​​becoming a breeder...but...are there really many rewards?"Tengteng Snake, what do you think?" So, Lin Feng threw this problem to Tengteng Snake."Tengteng?" "Tengteng..." It shook its head, indicating that it could not understand the words above. In all the content above, it could only recognize one Gardevoir... "You agree, right? Well, I'll sign up." Lin Feng walked into the supermarket excitedly.
